text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-01",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-01 through OP-07 cite page 51 ('At Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7,3, and 8.1, no other data will be collected'), which does not support the specific target days, PK hour labels, event groups, or visit windows defined in these operations; that schedule information appears in Table 1 on page 44."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-02",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "Table 1 on page 44 specifies an allowed visit window of ±1 day for Visits 2.2 (Day 6), 2.3 (Day 10), and 7.3 (Day 80), whereas OP-02, OP-03, and OP-06 omit visit windows entirely."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 schedules Visit 8.1 at Day 91 with a ±1 day window and labels it 'PK 504h post V7', contradicting Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), which specify Visit 8.1 at Day 90 with a ±2 day window (480 h after the 6th administration)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '504 h' to the PKTPT codelist instead of '480 h', contradicting the protocol PK schedule on pages 27 and 51 which specifies 480 h (Day 90) post 6th dose; additionally, the cited quote from page 27 only covers the 1st dose timepoints up to 240 h."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "PK subgroup visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1 apply only to the Mainland China PK subgroup (PKSUB = 'Yes' on RAND), but OP-01 through OP-07 add them as non-dynamic static events for all subjects with no gating rule."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-16",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-14 through OP-16 create the new ADA sampling form and assign it only to V3, leaving out Visits V2, V4, V6, V8, and V9 where anti-TJ301 antibody sampling is also required per Table 1 (p. 45), Section 6.2.3–6.3 (pp. 50–52), and Figure 5 (p. 47)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-19",
      "change_id": "CH-19",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-17 through OP-19 create a combined DIARY form ('Patient Diary Dispensed and Reviewed') and assign it only to V2, missing diary dispensing/review at V1, V1.1, and V3–V8 (Table 1, p. 44) and conflating two distinct activities because V1 only dispenses the diary and V8 only reviews it."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-20",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Protocol V1.1 is internally inconsistent on the screening endoscopy window: Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34), Table 1 footnote c (p. 45), and Section 6.2.2 bullet 9 (p. 49) require Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, whereas Table 1 footnote b (p. 45) says 'within 35 days' and Section 6.2.2 paragraph 3 (p. 49) still states 'within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-21",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-21 adds an edit check requiring exact equality `hours_between(EX.EXSTDTC, EX.EXENDTC) != 2`, which is stricter than the removed ±3 min tolerance and contradicts the amendment rationale on page 94 ('For some sites, it may be difficult to control the dosing time within ±3 min')."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-22",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-22 and OP-23 provide no source_page, source_quote, or source_change_ids to trace their rule and SDV review plan updates to the protocol."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Because the current casebook omits several baseline protocol forms (such as Physical Examination and Biomarkers) and already incorporates some V1.1 updates (such as RAND stratification items, PKTPT '2 h (EOI)', and TB at V9), it could not be verified whether omitted visits on newly created forms (ADA, DIARY) were intentionally out of scope of a delta-only diff or whether exact syntax of `days_between` and `hours_between` in the target EDC engine truncates or rounds fractional units."
}
